home.overviewIntro: The Secondary Education for Human Capital Competitiveness Project (SE4HC) will support priorities of phase 2 of Cambodia's Secondary Education Blueprint (CAMSEB) 2030. The project's impact is aligned with the government's Pentagonal Strategy and CAMSEB which highlight the importance of high-quality human resources to develop a knowledge-based society. The outcome will be effectiveness of a gender-inclusive upper secondary education system improved.
home.overviewFinancing: The project is estimated to cost $83.92 million, to be financed with a concessional loan of $80.00 million from ADB and government counterpart financing of $3.92 million.
home.infraText: Construct 414 additional classrooms, upgrade existing facilities with modern labs, libraries, and smart classrooms across 259 secondary schools.
home.capacityText: Provide comprehensive professional development for 3,000+ teachers focusing on STEM education and 21st-century skills.
home.systemText: Strengthen assessment systems, improve learning outcomes, and enhance alignment with post-secondary education pathways.

about.title: About the SE4HC Project
about.subtitle: Comprehensive information about the Secondary Education for Human Capital Competitiveness Project — transforming Cambodia's secondary education through innovation, infrastructure, and capacity building.
about.overviewText: The Secondary Education for Human Capital Competitiveness (SE4HC) project will support priorities of phase 2 of Cambodia's Secondary Education Blueprint (CAMSEB) 2030. The project's impact is aligned with the government's Pentagonal Strategy to develop high-quality human resources for a knowledge-based society.
about.rationaleText: Persistent constraints in secondary education include: (i) low access and completion, (ii) poor alignment with 21st century skills and employ-ability skills, (iii) inadequate effective learning assessment system, and (iv) lack of clear align-ment and flexibility between secondary and post-secondary education pathways.
about.rationaleText2: To address these challenges, the project will employ a STEM-innovative approach, systema-tic institutional and capacity building, teacher qualification upgrading, and the provision of climate-resilient and digital school infrastructure and facilities. This project is aligned with the CAMSEB 2030 and the Education Strategic Plan 2023-2028, which prioritizes equitable access to quality education and seeks to overcome the aforementioned constraints.
about.rationaleText3: Furthermore, it strongly supports the national digital education strategy for schools by building a conducive digital environment, enhancing digital literacy for both students and teachers, and promoting online learning opportunities. As such, the project is closely aligned with the government’s pentagonal strategy to enhance the quality of education, science, technology, and technical skills.
about.structureText: The SE4HC project is implemented through a coordinated management structure under the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS), with the Institute of Technology of Cambodia (ITC) serving as the Implementing Agency.
